controls.MAYA: A calm adult woman podcast host, clear, warm, curious, natural pace, confident but not theatrical.
controls.NARIN: A thoughtful adult man co-host, clear, conversational, curious, natural pace, slightly lighter energy.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: You ask for a name online, and a moment later your device has somewhere to send the request. It feels like one quick lookup.
turns.render_text: You ask for a name online, and a moment later your device has somewhere to send the request. It feels like one quick lookup.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: As if the internet keeps one enormous directory?
turns.render_text: As if the internet keeps one enormous directory?

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Exactly. But the useful mental model is not one directory. It is a delegated conversation—and sometimes that conversation does not happen at all because an earlier answer can still be reused.
turns.render_text: Exactly. But the useful mental model is not one directory. It is a delegated conversation—and sometimes that conversation does not happen at all because an earlier answer can still be reused.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: So the tiny pause hides either a journey or a memory.
turns.render_text: So the tiny pause hides either a journey or a memory.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: That distinction explains two everyday mysteries: why a repeated lookup can avoid going back to the original source, and why the answer is never something a resolver should remember forever.
turns.render_text: That distinction explains two everyday mysteries: why a repeated lookup can avoid going back to the original source, and why the answer is never something a resolver should remember forever.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: The speed and the expiry come from the same design?
turns.render_text: The speed and the expiry come from the same design?

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Right. Reuse saves work. A time limit prevents that reused data from becoming permanent truth.
turns.render_text: Right. Reuse saves work. A time limit prevents that reused data from becoming permanent truth.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Let me try the simple version: my device asks DNS for a name, DNS returns an address, done.
turns.render_text: Let me try the simple version: my device asks D N S for a name, D N S returns an address, done.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: That sentence collapses several jobs into one. A resolver asks questions for a client. In recursive mode, the server takes responsibility for obtaining a final answer. During iterative resolution, the next response may instead be a referral telling the resolver where to continue.
turns.render_text: That sentence collapses several jobs into one. A resolver asks questions for a client. In recursive mode, the server takes responsibility for obtaining a final answer. During iterative resolution, the next response may instead be a referral telling the resolver where to continue.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: And the authoritative server?
turns.render_text: And the authoritative server?

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Different job. It answers from local knowledge about the zone it serves. It is not the part wandering around asking other servers.
turns.render_text: Different job. It answers from local knowledge about the zone it serves. It is not the part wandering around asking other servers.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Start with the question. It identifies a domain name, a query type, and a query class.
turns.render_text: Start with the question. It identifies a domain name, a query type, and a query class.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: So even the question is more precise than “where is this name?”
turns.render_text: So even the question is more precise than “where is this name?”

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Yes. Then the resolver checks local information first. If it cannot answer there, it chooses servers, sends queries, and examines the responses.
turns.render_text: Yes. Then the resolver checks local information first. If it cannot answer there, it chooses servers, sends queries, and examines the responses.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Where does the hierarchy enter?
turns.render_text: Where does the hierarchy enter?

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: DNS names form a tree. Information is organized into zones, and referrals let the resolver continue through that structure until it reaches relevant authoritative knowledge.
turns.render_text: D N S names form a tree. Information is organized into zones, and referrals let the resolver continue through that structure until it reaches relevant authoritative knowledge.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Then the answer travels back through the resolver to the client.
turns.render_text: Then the answer travels back through the resolver to the client.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: And the response has structure. The base message format has a header followed by question, answer, authority, and additional sections. That matters, but it is supporting machinery. The core idea is still: check, ask, follow, and return.
turns.render_text: And the response has structure. The base message format has a header followed by question, answer, authority, and additional sections. That matters, but it is supporting machinery. The core idea is still: check, ask, follow, and return.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Give me a concrete run.
turns.render_text: Give me a concrete run.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Imagine asking for an address record for a made-up service name. On the first run, the resolver has no reusable answer. It checks local information, follows the needed referrals, and obtains an answer from authoritative data.
turns.render_text: Imagine asking for an address record for a made-up service name. On the first run, the resolver has no reusable answer. It checks local information, follows the needed referrals, and obtains an answer from authoritative data.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: And address answers use A or AAAA records.
turns.render_text: And address answers use A or quad A records.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Correct. Now ask again while the cached record is still reusable. The resolver may answer from that cache before consulting an authoritative server again.
turns.render_text: Correct. Now ask again while the cached record is still reusable. The resolver may answer from that cache before consulting an authoritative server again.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Same question, shorter journey.
turns.render_text: Same question, shorter journey.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Or no external journey at all.
turns.render_text: Or no external journey at all.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: I want the three roles in one clean comparison.
turns.render_text: I want the three roles in one clean comparison.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Recursive means: “Take responsibility for bringing me a final answer.” Iterative means: “Here is a referral; continue the search there.” Authoritative means: “I can answer from local knowledge for the zone I serve.”
turns.render_text: Recursive means: “Take responsibility for bringing me a final answer.” Iterative means: “Here is a referral; continue the search there.” Authoritative means: “I can answer from local knowledge for the zone I serve.”

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: One accepts responsibility, one advances the route, and one holds the relevant local data.
turns.render_text: One accepts responsibility, one advances the route, and one holds the relevant local data.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Exactly. Keeping those roles separate prevents the system from sounding like one mysterious DNS machine.
turns.render_text: Exactly. Keeping those roles separate prevents the system from sounding like one mysterious D N S machine.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Mistake one: every lookup goes directly to an authoritative server.
turns.render_text: Mistake one: every lookup goes directly to an authoritative server.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Cached data can answer first, so no.
turns.render_text: Cached data can answer first, so no.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Mistake two: an authoritative server searches other servers until it finds something.
turns.render_text: Mistake two: an authoritative server searches other servers until it finds something.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Also no. Its defining role here is answering from local zone knowledge.
turns.render_text: Also no. Its defining role here is answering from local zone knowledge.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Mistake three: if a record has not reached its TTL, the answer is guaranteed to be correct.
turns.render_text: Mistake three: if a record has not reached its T T L, the answer is guaranteed to be correct.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: TTL says how long cached data may be reused before the information source should be consulted again. It is a reuse boundary, not a proof that the underlying claim is true.
turns.render_text: T T L says how long cached data may be reused before the information source should be consulted again. It is a reuse boundary, not a proof that the underlying claim is true.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: And not every DNS question has to request an address, because the question carries a record type.
turns.render_text: And not every D N S question has to request an address, because the question carries a record type.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Good. An address lookup is one useful example, not the definition of every DNS exchange.
turns.render_text: Good. An address lookup is one useful example, not the definition of every D N S exchange.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: Five verbs. Ask: form a question with a name, type, and class. Check: inspect local information and cache. Follow: use referrals when the answer is not local. Answer: obtain relevant authoritative data. Reuse: keep cached data only within its TTL boundary.
turns.render_text: Five verbs. Ask: form a question with a name, type, and class. Check: inspect local information and cache. Follow: use referrals when the answer is not local. Answer: obtain relevant authoritative data. Reuse: keep cached data only within its T T L boundary.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: Ask, check, follow, answer, reuse. That is much easier to remember than a list of server names.
turns.render_text: Ask, check, follow, answer, reuse. That is much easier to remember than a list of server names.

turns.speaker: NARIN
turns.script_text: So DNS resolution is not a permanent answer fetched from one universal directory.
turns.render_text: So D N S resolution is not a permanent answer fetched from one universal directory.

turns.speaker: MAYA
turns.script_text: It is a delegated answer assembled through distinct roles, sometimes shortened by memory, and always bounded by what the evidence and its reuse window actually support.
turns.render_text: It is a delegated answer assembled through distinct roles, sometimes shortened by memory, and always bounded by what the evidence and its reuse window actually support.
